route_questions: What exactly is being claimed or asked?
What observation or test would falsify it?
What is the source-to-artifact-to-claim provenance chain?
What counterevidence or contradiction is already known?
What remains unknown and must stay TOKEN_VAZIO?
How urgent and necessary is this route, and why?
What exact next action can reduce uncertainty without promoting the claim?

routes.title: Nature reports OTOC^(2) sensitivity at long times and constructive interference among Pauli-string loops
evidence_for: Nature 646, 825–830 (2025), DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-09526-6: abstract/main text reports long-timescale sensitivity and constructive interference between Pauli strings forming large loops.
routes.falsifier: Reanalysis of the released circuits/data, or an independent reproduction under matched protocol, fails to recover the reported OTOC^(2) sensitivity/interference beyond the stated uncertainty and error-mitigation assumptions.
F_gap: Independent reproduction outside the author collaboration is not recorded in this route.
F_next: Link the released Zenodo circuits/data and reproduce at least one small classically tractable figure before widening the claim.
F_esquecido: Keep time-reversal protocol assumptions and error-mitigation normalization attached to any downstream reuse.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Acquire the public data/circuit release and bind immutable hashes to this route.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Hashes and a small reproducible analysis must be recorded as producer evidence.

F_otimizar: Separate experimentally observed interference from interpretations about computational advantage.
F_evolucao: Promote only after an independent or locally reproducible subset is attached.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: The robustness of the interference signature across unrelated hardware and physical Hamiltonians remains outside this paper's direct evidence.

routes.title: For the studied 65-qubit circuits, the paper estimates tensor-network simulation at about 3.2 years versus 2.1 hours of experimental collection, roughly 13,000x
evidence_for: Nature DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-09526-6, Fig. 4 discussion: 65-qubit geometry; projected SNR 2–3; tensor-network estimate ~3.2 years on Frontier; experimental collection 2.1 h per circuit; ~13,000 factor.
evidence_against: The paper frames the result as beyond reach of currently known classical algorithms, not a proof that no future classical method can close the gap.
routes.falsifier: A classical method reproduces the same target observable on the same circuit family and required accuracy at materially lower cost, invalidating the claimed current cost separation.
F_gap: No theorem of permanent classical impossibility is established.
Cost separation depends on accuracy target, circuit family, optimization assumptions and classical hardware/methods.
F_next: Re-run the classical cost benchmark when materially better contraction/Monte-Carlo methods or hardware become available.
F_esquecido: Treat the 13,000x figure as time-stamped and method-conditional; never store it as an eternal constant.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Maintain a classical-red-team route beside every performance claim.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Any new classical result must either preserve, reduce or close the recorded gap with provenance.

F_otimizar: Store benchmark assumptions next to the ratio so the headline cannot detach from its denominator and accuracy target.
F_evolucao: Track the ratio as a dated benchmark series rather than a single invariant.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Best future classical complexity for this observable family is unknown.

routes.title: The Nature paper's Hamiltonian-learning demonstration is a toy-model proof of principle; a practically relevant physical application is left for future work
evidence_for: Nature DOI 10.1038/s41586-025-09526-6 conclusion: progress on criteria (1) and (2), proof-of-principle for criterion (3); random-circuit dynamic-learning demo remains a toy model; real-world application left for future work.
evidence_against: Google's first-party research blog describes a separate NMR preprint as a path toward molecular applications, while stating that initial demonstration is not yet beyond classical.
routes.falsifier: A peer-reviewed, independently reproducible physical-system Hamiltonian-learning experiment using this protocol demonstrates practically relevant information in a regime beyond competitive classical methods.
F_gap: Practical quantum advantage in a real physical Hamiltonian-learning task is not closed by the Nature toy model.
F_next: Track the NMR/molecular follow-up separately and require peer-reviewed evidence plus classical baseline before closing this boundary.
F_esquecido: Do not conflate the random-circuit benchmark with the separate real-system NMR proof-of-concept.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Keep 'beyond-classical benchmark' and 'practical real-world application' as separate route states.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: A promotion gate must fail if either phrase is inferred from the other without direct evidence.

F_otimizar: Prevent headline compression from collapsing three criteria of practical advantage into one.
F_evolucao: Close this route only when criterion (3) is demonstrated in a practically relevant system with competitive classical baselines.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Whether useful physical-system OTOC Hamiltonian learning will retain beyond-classical separation is unknown.

routes.title: DIRECT: OTOC^(2) may retain enough signal and classical hardness in structured physical Hamiltonians to support useful parameter learning
evidence_for: The Nature paper demonstrates signal sensitivity and a toy Hamiltonian-learning example, but not this real-system claim.
routes.falsifier: On representative physical Hamiltonians, OTOC^(2) learning fails to beat matched classical or non-echo baselines in accuracy/cost, or signal/noise collapses before useful parameter recovery.
F_gap: No beyond-classical useful physical-system demonstration is attached.
F_next: Define one physical Hamiltonian family, target parameter, accuracy metric and classical baseline before experimentation.

F_providencia_operacional.verification: Benchmark must declare Hamiltonian, observable, noise model, target accuracy and classical comparator.

F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Unknown whether the random-circuit hardness mechanism transfers to structured physical Hamiltonians.

token_vazio.reason: Primary paper leaves practical physical application for future work.
token_vazio.next_test: Run or locate a peer-reviewed real-system benchmark with matched classical baselines.

routes.title: INVERSE: structure-exploiting classical algorithms may substantially shrink or erase the reported OTOC cost gap on relevant instance families
evidence_against: The paper reports nine attempted classical approaches and estimates a large current gap on its benchmark family.
routes.falsifier: After strong structure-aware classical red-teaming across the target family, no method reaches the required SNR/cost region and lower bounds or robust scaling evidence support persistent separation.
F_gap: No exhaustive future-proof classical lower bound exists.
F_next: Continuously benchmark new tensor-network, Monte-Carlo and structure-specific methods on immutable instances.
F_esquecido: Reopen whenever a materially new classical algorithm or hardware regime appears.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Maintain frozen benchmark instances and accuracy targets.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Every classical-red-team result must be comparable against the same target observable and SNR.

F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Unknown whether the observed separation is asymptotically robust or benchmark-specific.

token_vazio.next_test: Run new classical methods against the frozen benchmark set.

routes.title: BOUNDARY: the 13,000x number is conditional on the 2025 circuit family, target accuracy, cost model and classical methods tested
evidence_for: Nature explicitly qualifies the result as 'at present' beyond-classical and describes an estimated tensor-network cost.
routes.falsifier: A source establishes a hardware- and algorithm-independent lower bound yielding the same ratio across the claimed domain.
F_gap: No invariant 13,000x constant exists across all quantum tasks.
F_next: Encode benchmark date, method, accuracy and hardware metadata whenever this ratio is cited.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Reject any route that stores 13,000x without its benchmark scope.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Validator or review must require circuit family, classical method and accuracy context.

F_otimizar: Compress the claim only after preserving its scope metadata.
F_evolucao: Measure fewer decontextualized benchmark claims over time.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: How fast the ratio will change with new classical algorithms/hardware is unknown.

routes.title: COUNTEREXAMPLE: seek a matched classical reproduction that reaches the 65-qubit target observable and accuracy at comparable practical cost
routes.falsifier: If such a reproduction is found under the frozen benchmark contract, it falsifies the broad current 'beyond-classical under known methods' route or forces its scope to narrow.
F_next: Freeze benchmark inputs, target observable, SNR and cost accounting so a classical challenger can be compared fairly.
F_esquecido: A failed 2025 classical method does not permanently exclude its future descendants.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Create a red-team leaderboard for classical challengers.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Entries require code/commit, environment, runtime, accuracy and cost receipts.

F_otimizar: Use one benchmark contract for both quantum and classical routes.
F_evolucao: Count successful falsification attempts and scope refinements, not only confirmations.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: The strongest presently untested classical challenger is unknown.

routes.title: PARABOLA: Pauli-string loops can serve as a didactic image for semantic routes that leave a concept, traverse transformations and return under consistency constraints
routes.falsifier: There is no literal physical claim to falsify; any extracted software/mathematical subclaim must be instantiated as a separate route.
F_gap: The analogy does not imply that RAFAELIA semantic graphs are quantum systems or Pauli spaces.
F_next: Use only as explanatory notation; split any operational proposition into its own hypothesis with tests.
F_esquecido: Retain the boundary 'analogy != mechanism' wherever this parabola is referenced.
F_otimizar: Keep symbolic pedagogy separate from evidence-bearing physics.
F_evolucao: A good parabola yields clearer testable subclaims without increasing claim_allowed.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Whether the analogy improves navigation quality is an empirical UX question, not physics.

routes.title: ADJACENT TRANSFER: echo-like forward/perturb/reverse/compare can inspire a software audit pattern for provenance, without asserting a quantum mechanism
routes.falsifier: As a software design hypothesis, falsify it if controlled audit fixtures show no improvement in detecting provenance corruption, regression or hidden transformation relative to simpler checks.
F_gap: No software benchmark currently demonstrates benefit.
F_next: Build a synthetic provenance fixture with reversible transformations and injected corruption; compare detection rates against baseline hashing/lineage checks.
F_esquecido: Do not map physical time reversal to literal reversal of irreversible data operations.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Prototype the audit pattern only on synthetic data.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Report detection precision/recall and overhead against a simpler provenance baseline.

F_otimizar: Adopt only if it adds measurable audit value beyond existing hash/lineage gates.
F_evolucao: Promote from analogy to software pattern only after adversarial fixture results.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: Unknown whether an echo-inspired audit adds anything beyond existing deterministic provenance gates.

routes.title: UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN: which structural properties of real Hamiltonians preserve large-loop interference, measurable OTOC signal and classical hardness simultaneously?
routes.falsifier: The question closes only when a defined domain has measured scaling laws or counterexamples sufficient to delimit those properties; absence of such evidence preserves TOKEN_VAZIO.
F_gap: No general transfer law from random circuits to practically relevant Hamiltonians is established by the seed paper.
F_next: Define candidate structural variables: locality, dimensionality, integrability/chaos, interaction graph, disorder, conservation laws and noise; test one family at a time.
F_esquecido: Search for negative cases where interference exists but useful learning or classical hardness does not.

F_providencia_operacional.action: Create a structure-by-evidence matrix for one Hamiltonian family.
F_providencia_operacional.verification: Every cell must cite measurement/simulation or remain TOKEN_VAZIO.

F_otimizar: Prefer one controlled family over broad unsourced cross-domain analogy.
F_evolucao: Reduce TOKEN_VAZIO cells through targeted falsification experiments.
F_so_sei_q_nada_sei: The relevant structural invariants are not yet known.

token_vazio.reason: The seed paper does not establish a general law connecting real-system structure to useful beyond-classical OTOC learning.
token_vazio.next_test: Map one controlled Hamiltonian family across structure, signal, learnability and classical cost.
